The Encounter — first contact across substrates

An alien — generated from planetary and biological parameters — running the same cognitive architecture you use, with different substrate. Their seeds are shaped by what their world rewarded. Their starter corpus is what their kind has read. You meet here on neutral ground, with nothing in common except the architecture itself and a few universal concepts. What follows is the test: can two minds with utterly different substrates find a shared workspace?
